description: This file defines a Broker class that manages a subprocess running a 'cargo' command for a data broker, and a main function that initializes this broker with configuration data loaded from a file specified via command-line arguments. It appears to be part of a stress test setup for the Kuksa Val project.

classes.name: Broker
classes.description: A class that manages starting a data broker subprocess with parameters from a configuration object.

methods.name: Broker.__init__
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Broker with a configuration.

methods.name: Broker.start
methods.description: Method to start the data broker subprocess with parameters from the configuration.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments, load configuration, and initialize and start the Broker.
